rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken expression for going to get something and bringing it back.

example.english: Please fetch that book for me.
example.jyutping: bong1 ngo5 lo2 faan1 lei4 go2 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this when saying that something sells for or reaches a particular price, with A as the amount.

example.english: This painting can fetch thirty thousand dollars at auction.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫喺拍賣會賣到三萬蚊。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 hai2 paak3 maai6 wui2 maai6 dou2 saam1 maan6 man1
